author: _Courtney
body:
So, I've only been playing this server for a few weeks now and it has easily become one of my favorites. 

However, I feel as if the server is missing something, and that is Survival. 
Not only will it bring in more players (more people who like to build in peace, show off their skills and overall just have a fun time inside a safe environment where they won't be attacked, griefed, etc.) 

Some people will probably call me out on this, but I build houses occasionally on the DTM game mode with my good friend Murph_the_cat, most of you have probably seen us being odd and making houses/huts. 

Even if it is just us two playing Survival, it would mean a lot because we would finally be able to build without people coming and killing us, or placing blocks all over our homes. 

It'll also be a good alternative for people who do not like to PvP, or are not very good (myself as an example). I also think building is a great way to calm down and really show your creativity. Survival is an insanely popular gamemode on many servers and like I said above, is a great way to bring in new players and I feel that is what the server is lacking recently. (Since the max capacity is 1178, or I'm not sure what it is, and the server typically has 70-100 people on daily.) 

Anyway, I believe Murph will insert screenshots of some of our work that we have made during various games in DTM.
Also, I'm not sure if anyone has spoken about this before since I am not an old member of the server.

Thanks for considering this!

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
Great post, Courtney!!  Great Idea!!! :)

I think this topic has been discussed before, but with the new Atlas update, this would be a perfect time to revisit.

Reasons to add one server for survival:

1) Break from PVP - After pounding away on players (or vice versa), it's nice to take a break, relax, and build a house...not a huge, complex structure, but a sweet, small, and cozy home.  I have witnessed PVP gods and mods engaging in this activity, so Avicus is NOT an exclusive PVP server.  Everyone wants to build at some point.

2) Less disruptive - Sometimes players come and grief our houses for no reason except that they want us to PVP instead. It would be nice to have a separate server for our houses or villages, so that intense PVP players don't get upset and do things they will regret later.

3) Community - Why not keep the loyal Avicus players on the Avicus server?  The player count remains constant while still fulfilling the need to build.  Don't tell us to go to a completely different server to build...keep us right here where we belong.

I know there would be concerns of griefing during survival, but I'm sure you all could come up with something that was manageable, like no TNT, no firespread, provide food, maybe reset every 24 hours, etc...

Here are some nebula builds (nothing spectacular, but fun was had building them)!  Please reconsider survival!!!

http://imgur.com/DBUqZKz
http://imgur.com/ScnlBK3
http://imgur.com/KRGGVYc
http://imgur.com/LFoPTqe
